Component map: which series each role uses

Tests read their inputs through this table. A test that departs from it says so, with its reason. The cash leg, for example, is the dividend-reinvested LIQUIDBEES level, because the LIQUIDBEES price is flat by design.

RoleSeries usedWhy this oneConvention
CalendarD01 calendar.csv (NSE sessions from Refinitiv .NSEI)The production job's own calendar; the signals are built on itA series' row on a date outside this calendar is ignored; on a session where a series has no row, its last value is carried. Two Budget sessions are missing (F-AA-D02)
Equity switch signalD03 SIGN of Master_Nifty100, Master_MC100, Master_SC100 (frozen 2026-09-25)The production signals, unmodifiedAt a decision date d, read the latest weekly row dated on or before d
Parent basketsD05 Rebalance_history (frozen 2026-09-25)The parents' real basketsEffective from availableDate; joined to prices by ISIN; weights renormalised to sum to 1
Stock fill priceD06 (2014-21) and D07 (2021-26): Eikon OHLC4 of the next sessionAdjusted for splits, bonuses and demergers; Kite (D08) is notThe close when the open is missing
Stock valuationD06 / D07 Eikon closeAs aboveCarried forward over sessions without a row
GoldD09 GOLDBEES Eikon close (valuation); X02 de-spiked OHLC4 (fills)Agrees with Kite; the spikes are in open, high and low onlyCarried forward over the special sessions it lacks
CashD11 LBES adjusted level: LIQUIDBEES with its daily dividends reinvestedThe LIQUIDBEES price is flat by design and returns 0%As-of: on each NSE session take the latest posted level. Past the file's last date, accrue at the trailing 90-session daily rate, and count those days in the run's audit
ComparatorsD14 published parent NAVs; D15 published AA NAVsWhat the smallcases actually reportedCommon dates only; rebase on a session both series hold
BenchmarksD02 index closes (Nifty 50, Nifty 100, Midcap 100, Smallcap 100)Same source as the signalsPrice indices: excess over them is excess over a price index
Gold signal (final strategy only, not T02)D13 Master_MAUc1Production code on MCX goldAs the equity switch signal

Inputs of T03 (added 2026-11-05)

T03 tests the three-index switch on the four parents' own stocks over 2019-01-02 → 2026-08-21. Three inputs are new to this review: D17 (published parent NAVs from 2019), D18 (per-parent stock OHLC, from the holdings matrix) and D19 (basket weights). The rest were reviewed on 2026-10-22; their verdicts are unchanged and only their use by T03 is added here.

IDInputVerdictT03 uses it forImpact on T03
D01NSE trading calendar (Nifty 50 sessions)!PASS WITH NOTESReference calendar for the weekly Friday review (the last session of each week).Five real sessions are absent from it (F-AA-D02). T03 values and trades on D17's dates, which include the three Budget sessions the calendar lacks; the Friday review is the last D17 session of the week.
D03Index signals: Master_{Nifty100, MC100, SC100}.xlsx✓PASSSIGN of the Nifty 100, Midcap 100 and Smallcap 100 supertrends: the three-index switch.Rows before 2021 are a backfill by the production code, not signals traded at the time, so the 2019-2021 decisions are what the rule would have said, not what was done. T03 states this in section 3.
D05Parent baskets: Rebalance_history_by_scid_SCMO_{0003,0007,0010,0029}.csv!PASS WITH NOTESavailableDate of each basket and which baskets are skipped; the weights come from D19.Skipped baskets (F-AA-D07) are dropped. D19's weights equal D05's to 5e-13.
D09GOLDBEES daily OHLC (Eikon)!PASS WITH NOTESGOLDBEES open, high, low and close: the gold half of the out-of-equity sleeve.Eikon's high and low carry ETF-only spikes, so the fill is the de-spiked OHLC4 (X02). The Budget sessions are in GOLDBEES but not in the calendar (F-AA-D02); T03 uses D17's dates.
D11Cash: LBES adjusted level (LIQUIDBEES with dividends reinvested)✕FAILLBES adjusted level: the cash half of the sleeve (50% of it).FAIL because its source is not recorded (F-AA-D09). Impact, against the desk's own LIQUIDCASE file (liquidEtfFinal) over T03's window 2019-01-02 to 2026-08-07: LBES compounds 4.19% a year, LIQUIDCASE 4.37%, a gap of 0.18 pp/yr; the two are identical until 2024-01-24 and differ by 0.54 pp/yr after. With cash at half the sleeve, the cash leg can move a book's CAGR by at most 0.09 pp/yr even if it were always out, and moves every null draw's CAGR in the same direction, so the comparison with the nulls is not affected. Past 2026-08-09 the level accrues at the trailing 90-session rate (F-AA-D05).
D12MAUc1 daily OHLCV (MCX gold futures, continuous)!PASS WITH NOTESMCX gold futures (MAUc1) daily range, only to de-spike GOLDBEES's fill price.No gold-timing signal is used in T03. The de-spiking changes 552 of 3,019 GOLDBEES fill prices, by a median of -0.20% (X02).
D17Published parent NAVs, 2019-2026 (export of 2026-10-22)!PASS WITH NOTESPublished parent NAVs: the G0 gate, T03's calendar, and the hold-the-parent comparator.Source not recorded, so PASS WITH NOTES. Equal to D14 on their common dates; the rebuild matches it within G0. T03's calendar is its dates.
D18Stock OHLC per parent (holdings matrix)!PASS WITH NOTESEvery stock's OHLC for fills (OHLC4) and valuation (close).0 missing stock-sessions; 31 carried bars, 19 of them in T03's window; the engine applies the Polyplex correction (F-AA-D14); the eight sessions D17 skips are never read (F-AA-D15).
D19Parent basket weights (holding weight matrix)!PASS WITH NOTESTarget weights of every basket, on its availableDate.Equals D05's to 5e-13; skipped baskets are dropped.

Conditions T03 carries

  • F-AA-D09 stays OPEN and is escalated to Manu: who exported the LBES cash file (D11) and the published NAVs (D17), from which system, on what date. Until then D17 is PASS WITH NOTES and D11 is FAIL with its impact bounded at 0.09 pp/yr on a book's CAGR (and the same in every null draw).
  • F-AA-D01 stays OPEN for D06 and D07 but does not touch D18, so it does not block T03.
  • No D17 or D18 value has been compared with a public source (the same gap as the spot checks of 2026-10-22). T03's pre-registration lists it as a known limit.
  • The review as a whole stays DRAFT.

D18: stock OHLC per parent

One row per stock per session on which it has a bar. Missing = needed stock-sessions with no bar on a real session; carried = a flat bar at the last close, only on sessions where a held stock had no bar (listed in *_ohlc_filled_cells.csv). Prices are Eikon, adjusted for splits, bonuses and demergers, not dividends; Polyplex needs price_corrections.csv (F-AA-D14).

move(t) = close(t) ÷ close(previous row) − 1

Reconciliation of overlapping sources

Pairs compared on their common dates, on returns, never on levels:

CAGR = (P_last ÷ P_first)^(365.25 ÷ calendar days between them) − 1 gap per year = CAGR(first series) − CAGR(second series), in percentage points correlation = Pearson correlation of the two daily return series on common dates

Derived series

Harness parents (X01)

Each parent is rebuilt from its real baskets: a basket takes effect on its availableDate; trades fill at the next session's OHLC4 from the Eikon file; holdings drift between baskets; returns are price return (no dividends). Built by analysis/final_strategy.py. 2014-21 has no published series to check against and inherits F-AA-D01. In 2021-26 it runs below the published NAVs (Reconciliation, first four rows).

GOLDBEES fill price, de-spiked (X02)

GOLDBEES's open, high and low carry ETF-only prints far from the close. The fill price clips high and low to MCX gold's daily range scaled to GOLDBEES, then takes OHLC4. Fill prices changed: 552 of 3019 days; median change -0.20%; 1st to 99th percentile -4.4% to +5.6%; largest 6.6%.

MAUc1 cleaned (D12)

The raw export's 3000 rows become 2997; 7 changes, each logged in analysis\evidence\final_strategy\mauc1\mauc1_cleaning_log.csv: holiday rows with no close dropped, close-only rows filled, one bar widened so high and low contain the close.

Cash: LBES adjusted (D11), return by calendar year

Plausible overnight-money rates in every year; first and last years are partial (2007-06-29 → 2007-12-31 is not shown; 2026 runs to 2026-08-09).

Data defects

F-AA-D01 OPENinputs D06, X01

In the 2014-21 Eikon price file, 13 ISINs' histories end on 2016-06-30 although the stocks kept trading (for example Lakshmi Vilas Bank to 2020, JMC Projects to 2023, Piramal Enterprises to 2025), and 2 held ISINs (INE202B01038, INE093A01041) have no rows at all. The 13 share one end date, which points to the fetch or the table, not the stocks.

Effect if ignored. Part of the parent baskets from mid-2016 to 2018 has no price (see Stock prices). The harness carries the last close or moves the weight to other names, so the 2014-21 parent rebuild, and every 2014-21 result built on it (final strategy, T01's 2015-21 window), is affected by an amount not yet measured.

Handling. Re-query ohlcv_eikon for these quote_ids with the VPN on. If the table has the rows, rebuild the file with a script; if not, find another source. Rerun the 2014-21 results.

F-AA-D02 ACCEPTEDinputs D01

The NSE calendar built from Refinitiv .NSEI lacks five real sessions since 2014: 2020-02-01 (Saturday, Budget), 2023-11-12 (Sunday, Muhurat), 2024-03-02 (Saturday, special session), 2025-02-01 (Saturday, Budget) and 2026-02-01 (Sunday, Budget). GOLDBEES from Kite has a row on all five; the published NAVs and GOLDBEES from Eikon on the two Budget days of 2025 and 2026. Yet the same calendar holds other special sessions (2016-10-30, 2019-10-27, 2020-11-14, 2024-01-20, 2024-05-18), so its coverage of special sessions is inconsistent.

Effect if ignored. An engine on this calendar folds those days into the next session. Negligible for multi-year returns; day-level comparisons are off by one day on those dates.

Handling. Accepted and noted. A project-built calendar would add the two days.

F-AA-D03 HANDLEDinputs D14, D15

The published NAV files skip 5 NSE sessions inside 2021-11-01 to 2026-08-21: the Muhurat sessions 2021-11-04, 2022-10-24, 2024-11-01 and 2025-10-21, and the special session 2024-05-18.

Effect if ignored. A comparison rebased on a session one series lacks gains or loses a day's return.

Handling. Compare on common dates only; rebase on a session both series hold.

F-AA-D04 HANDLEDinputs D06, D07, D09

Eikon lacks special weekend and Muhurat sessions: GOLDBEES lacks 2016-10-30, 2019-10-27, 2020-11-14, 2024-01-20 and 2024-05-18; stocks lack 2024-01-20 and 2024-05-18 (and the 2014-21 sessions listed in sessions_absent_from_stock_file.csv).

Effect if ignored. Prices are carried from the previous session on those days.

Handling. Carry the last close; count the days.

F-AA-D05 CONVENTION SETinputs D11

The cash file is posted on its own calendar: many dates that are not NSE sessions (most of them Sundays) and some NSE sessions absent. Past its last date (2026-08-09) the engines extend it two ways: flat (T01, final strategy 2014-21) and at the trailing rate (final strategy 2021-26).

Effect if ignored. Tiny on returns (cash moves about 0.02% a day), but two tests could disagree on the same days.

Handling. One convention for the project (see the component map). T02 follows it.

F-AA-D06 ACCEPTEDinputs D02, D04

Index OHLC: Nifty Smallcap 250 lacks 7 sessions, 5 in a row from 2022-02-24 to 2022-03-03; SC100's open, high and low are frozen at 3584.17 from 2011-04-01 to 2011-04-07 while its close moves; Nifty 100 lacks 2006-01-24 and SC100 lacks 3 sessions in 2005 and 2011.

Effect if ignored. The Smallcap 250 signal (comparator only) is computed on gapped data. The SC100 problems are before 2014, outside every backtest window, but they enter the supertrend's history.

Handling. Accepted for now; re-pull Smallcap 250 for 2022 if it is ever used in a test.

F-AA-D07 OPENinputs D05

Whole parent baskets are flagged skipped=True (0007 on 2020-03-16 and 2021-09-16; 0029 on some dates). Their weights are drifted, not equal, which suggests 'reviewed, not traded'. The harness trades to them as if they were new baskets.

Effect if ignored. Extra turnover and a small re-weighting on those dates in the rebuilt parents.

Handling. Decide whether a skipped basket should trade; if not, change the harness in a new run.

F-AA-D08 OPENinputs D07

The 2021-26 Eikon price file was saved by a one-off command on 2026-09-25; no script in the project rebuilds it.

Effect if ignored. The file cannot be reproduced if lost or questioned.

Handling. Add data/build_prices_2021_26.py that re-creates it from ohlcv_eikon and checks its sha256 against the inventory.

F-AA-D09 OPENinputs D11, D12, D14, D15, D16, D17

No record of who exported the cash file, the published NAV files and the AA weight files, from which system, or when; the MAUc1 export date is not recorded and the file sits in Downloads. The export of the published parent NAVs from 2019 (D17) has the same gap: Manu supplied the four files on 2026-10-23, but the system and query are not recorded.

Effect if ignored. A number built on these cannot be traced to its source.

Handling. Manu to name the sources (open questions); copy the MAUc1 export into Historical Data with its sha256. Until D17's source is recorded it stays PASS WITH NOTES (its agreement with D14 and with the rebuild is strong evidence); D11 stays FAIL.

F-AA-D10 OPENinputs X01

Over 2021-11-03 to 2026-08-21 the rebuilt parents run below the published NAVs on all four parents (see Reconciliation), most on 0029.

Effect if ignored. Levels of anything built on the rebuild are understated; rule-versus-hold comparisons on the same rebuild are not.

Handling. Before quoting a level, say it is the rebuild. Find out the published series' dividend basis (F-AA-D09).

F-AA-D11 OPENinputs D18, D05

The holdings matrix (data/holdings_matrix/*_holdings_matrix.csv) is 0/1 and carries no weights, and it lists three baskets the rebalance history flags skipped=true (0007 2020-03-16 and 2021-09-16, 0029 2020-03-16; see F-AA-D07).

Effect if ignored. A rebuild from the matrix alone is equal weight, which is wrong for most baskets (up to 0.8 pp/yr off the published NAV; 0010 is +6.5 pp off in 2020). Trading the three skipped baskets moves 0007 by -0.12 pp/yr and 0029 by -0.63 pp/yr over 2019-2026.

Handling. Use data/holdings_matrix/<p>_holding_weight_matrix.csv (Postgres smallcase_rebal_historical, equals the frozen CSV to 5e-13) and drop the csv_only_skipped rows unless a test says otherwise. Never use the 0/1 matrix as weights. Detail: data/parent_rebuild_hm/PARENT_REBUILD_HM.md.

F-AA-D12 OPENinputs D18

Postgres smallcase_rebal_historical is not a drop-in for the frozen rebalance CSV: (a) its rebalance_date is the decision date, not the CSV's date, so join on available_date; (b) each parent's newest basket has available_date NULL (match by identical holdings); (c) it has no skipped baskets; (d) one stock can carry two ISINs (TD Power Systems), so match on sid; (e) its latest dated basket (2026-06-15/23) is older than the CSV's 2026-09 baskets.

Effect if ignored. A naive join drops or misdates baskets and silently loses stocks.

Handling. data/build_holding_weight_matrix.py implements the joins above and records the source of every row in <p>_holding_weight_sources.csv.

F-AA-D14 RESOLVED for D18 via price_corrections.csv; D06/D07 and any other price source are not correctedinputs D18, D17

Eikon back-adjusts Polyplex (POLYPLEX.NS) for its Rs 100/share special dividend (ex-date 2021-02-17, cum close 911.20), although the file's stated rule is adjustment for splits, bonuses and demergers only. ohlcv_eikon prices before the ex-date are 811.20/911.20 = 0.8903 of traded prices (the step is visible against merged_historical_data_with_rics: ratio 0.8395 -> 0.9430 across 2021-02-16/17). The published SCMO_0007 price-return index takes the drop.

Effect if ignored. The rebuilt SCMO_0007 ran +118 bp above the published NAV on 2021-02-17 and never gave it back: +2.04 pp in calendar 2021, +0.27 pp/yr over 2019-2026 (G0 FAIL). This one event is the whole 'unexplained' 0007 2021 gap. A scan of every held stock in all four parents (ratio of ohlcv_eikon to merged_historical_data_with_rics, steps >= 2% while held) found no other persistent step in 2019-2026 that matches a published-NAV difference.

Handling. data/holdings_matrix/price_corrections.csv multiplies Polyplex prices dated before 2021-02-17 by 911.20/811.20 = 1.123274; data/parent_rebuild_hm.py applies it in the variant listed_weights_skip_dropped_corrected: 0007 2021 gap 2.04 -> 0.17 pp, full-window gap +0.27 -> +0.10 pp/yr, G0 PASS. The D18 *_ohlc.csv files are not edited; the T03 engine must apply price_corrections.csv when it reads them. Other special dividends that Eikon may have back-adjusted are not hunted beyond the scan above.

F-AA-D15 HANDLEDinputs D17, D18

The per-parent OHLC files (D18) have eight sessions that the published NAVs (D17) skip: six Diwali Muhurat evenings (2020-11-14, 2021-11-04, 2022-10-24, 2023-11-12, 2024-11-01, 2025-10-21) and two special Saturdays (2024-03-02, 2024-05-18). On 2021-11-04, 2022-10-24, 2024-11-01 and 2025-10-21 as many stocks have a bar as on the days around them; on the other four about 91% do. The reverse never happens: every D17 date is in D18. Neither has the Muhurat Sunday 2019-10-27. Both have the Budget sessions 2020-02-01, 2025-02-01 and 2026-02-01 and the special Saturday 2024-01-20, which the .NSEI calendar lacks (F-AA-D02).

Effect if ignored. A NAV valued on D18's dates would have extra days, and its daily returns would not line up with D17's. A trade on a date D17 skips would have no published value to compare with. No Kite fill is needed, because D18 is a superset of D17.

Handling. T03's calendar is D17's dates: every NAV, every trade and every decision date is on a D17 session, and D18 prices on the other eight dates are never read. The calendar rule goes into T03.md section 3.

Open questions for the desk

  1. Cash file (D11): which system and who produced LBES_Adjusted_Price_data_2026_08_10.csv, and when? Is it LIQUIDBEES's NAV with the daily dividends reinvested, and computed by whom?
  2. Published NAVs (D14, D15): which system exported parentIndices.csv and indices.csv, on what date, and do the levels include dividends?
  3. AA weight files (D16): the same Redash query (1235) as the parent baskets?
  4. MAUc1 (D12): when was MAUc1_daily1.csv exported? May it be copied into AA/Historical Data with its sha256?
  5. F-AA-D01: with the VPN on, the 2016-06-30 cut-off can be checked against ohlcv_eikon. Can you turn it on?
  6. F-AA-D07: when a parent basket is flagged skipped=True, did the smallcase trade on that date or not?
